description: Company OS as Code: a reference template that structures a company's operating knowledge, norms and decisions into one repository so humans and AI agents work on the same foundation (5-layer architecture plus governance templates).
rules: Create your organization's private repository with 'Use this template'; it shares no git history with the template, so apply upstream changes by hand.
Fill layer1/ (ORG-CLAUDE.md, data classification matrix, prohibited uses) before letting agents act on company work.
Read AGENTS.md first when operating as an AI agent inside a derived repository.
